newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Aug industrial output up 9.7 pct - FIEL.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Aug industrial output up 9.7 pct - FIEL.

text.p: Argentine industrial production rose by 9.7 percent in September compared to the same month last year, but dropped 3.7 percent from August, the private FIEL consultancy said Thursday.
Output was up 10.1 percent in the third quarter of 1996 compared with the same period last year, it said.
FIEL said the fall in September output from August was partly explained by fewer working days in the month.
"It is expected there will be a further rise (in company output) in the last quarter of the year," FIEL said.
